name: How long does basement drywall repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does basement drywall repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of basement drywall repair depends on the extent and type of damage. Small patches for minor holes or cracks might take a few hours, including drying time. More extensive repairs involving multiple sections, water damage remediation, or mold treatment can take several days. This includes preparation, drying each coat of mud, sanding, and priming. A professional assessment provides a more accurate timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies by damage extent; small patches take hours, while extensive repairs can take several days due to multiple steps and drying times.
